edit.description: ruleDefaultContract: the extent lines 200 clause moves under when(loads("launch"), ...), as its guidance already states

summary: The rule default contract's 200-line budget judges only rules that load at launch, matching its guidance; path-scoped and nested rules keep only the on-demand character limit
acceptance: A paths-scoped rule and a rule under a subdirectory's .claude/rules/, each past 200 lines, raise no extent lines finding; a root rule without paths past 200 lines still does
tests: a paths scoped rule past two hundred lines raises no extent lines finding
a rule under a subdirectory rules directory past two hundred lines raises no extent lines finding
pins: a root rule without paths past two hundred lines raises an extent lines finding
